messages:
Emily R: starting a DRY-RUN canary for v0.19.3-dry → target 5% traffic equivalent (probe-only, not switching live traffic). just exercising routing, kvcache, and metrics plumbing.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: DRY-RUN canary launched · target=5% · variant=v0.19.3-dry · mode=probe

Dan K: quick checklist: p95 latency, error-rate, token-cost, model-quality. @Ana O can you run the smoke eval set?

Ana O: on it. kicking off smoke eval now, should be ~5m.

Priya S: control plane routing looks clean. KV cache hit rate steady, no 429/503 spikes in the first 2 min.

Ana O: smoke eval done — no regressions on our smoke prompts. one mismatch on long-context case (id:392) looks like a contextual carryover edge-case, not model-level hallucination. attaching log snippet in thread.

Dan K: saw p95 +40ms in eu-west-1 for sequences >2k tokens, tail only. seems like warmup/kvcache. @Ops any thoughts?

ops-bot: ops-bot: alert — anomalous tail latency detected on host gpu-034 (eu-west-1). suspected kvcache coldness.

Ops: restarting one worker on eu-west-1 to clear kvcache and rebalance. will monitor for 2 cycles.

Priya S: post-restart metrics: p95 returned to baseline, no error bump. cache hit ratio recovered.

Priya S: recommend we keep this as DRY-RUN for another 15m then decide on live 5% cutover. nothing blocking from infra/serving side.

Emily R: quick vote — proceed to 5% live cutover after validation window, or hold? please respond with :thumbsup: to proceed, :thumbsdown: to hold.

Dan K: +1 (thumbsup) from ML. long-seq perf looks acceptable after restart.

Ana O: hold — request one more eval run with customer prompt set (small sample). running now.

Emily R: holding based on Ana's ask. ETA ~6m.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: DRY-RUN canary paused · status=human_hold · reason=pending_additional_eval

Ana O: customer-prompt eval finished — no functional regressions, one low-severity formatting diff in example 7. not blocking but worth note.

Emily R: decision: HOLD. will not cut live traffic tonight. we'll schedule another mini-dry-run in low-usage window (03:00-04:00 UTC) to revalidate warmup behavior before any traffic shift. I'll update release notes/change window.

Priya S: release-note draft saved: "v0.19.3 — routing and kvcache improvements; full rollout deferred due to observed tail-latency warmup. follow-up dry-run scheduled."

Emily R: thanks all. closing this thread for now — ping @Emily R if anything changes.
